# Scientific American

> Scientific American is a leading digital publication covering cutting-edge research across physics, biology, health, technology, and environmental science with expert analysis and multimedia storytelling.

Scientific American provides accessible science journalism and in-depth reporting on breakthrough discoveries, emerging technologies, and scientific debates. The site organizes content across major scientific disciplines while featuring podcasts, interactive games, and subscription access to the magazine.

## Key Topics

- Climate change
- Quantum physics
- CRISPR and genetics
- Neuroscience
- Artificial intelligence
- Cosmology and astronomy
- Women in science
- Medical innovation
- Biotechnology
- Environmental conservation
- Science fiction accuracy
- Materials science
- Vaccine research
- Astrobiology
- Physics and relativity

## Topic Hubs

- [Health](https://www.scientificamerican.com/health): Medical news, vaccines, and wellness articles covering breakthrough treatments and health research
- [Mind & Brain](https://www.scientificamerican.com/mind-and-brain): Neuroscience and psychology coverage exploring brain research, mental health, and cognitive science
- [Space & Physics](https://www.scientificamerican.com/space-and-physics): Astronomy, cosmology, and quantum physics content examining the universe and fundamental forces
- [The Environment](https://www.scientificamerican.com/environment): Climate science, ecology, and conservation coverage addressing environmental challenges
- [Technology](https://www.scientificamerican.com/technology): AI, aerospace, nuclear energy, and biotechnology reporting on technological innovation
- [Biology](https://www.scientificamerican.com/biology): CRISPR, genetics, and life sciences research exploring biological breakthroughs
- [Chemistry](https://www.scientificamerican.com/chemistry): Materials science, biochemistry, and molecular discovery in chemical research
- [Math](https://www.scientificamerican.com/math): Mathematical puzzles, statistics, and mathematical trends in contemporary science
- [Social Sciences](https://www.scientificamerican.com/social-sciences): Anthropology, archaeology, and social justice coverage in human sciences

## Featured Articles

- [Extreme U.S. heat wave smashes all-time hottest March temperature record](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/extreme-u-s-heat-wave-smashes-all-time-hottest-march-temperature-record): News coverage of record-breaking heat wave in western U.S. and climate implications
- [How accurate is the science in Project Hail Mary?](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/how-accurate-is-the-science-in-project-hail-mary): Science-fiction accuracy analysis of Project Hail Mary's quantum physics and astrobiology
- [New tests and alert systems spot kidney disease before irreversible damage](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/new-tests-and-alert-systems-spot-kidney-disease-before-irreversible-damage): Medical innovation in early detection of drug-induced kidney damage
- [Agnes Pockels' pioneering work was unfairly dismissed by tropes about women's domestic roles](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/agnes-pockels-pioneering-work-was-unfairly-dismissed-by-tropes-about-womens): Historical analysis of Agnes Pockels' surface science achievements and gender bias in science
- [Rival shadow group to RFK Jr.'s autism science committee meets in D.C.](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/rival-shadow-group-to-rfk-jr-s-autism-science-committee-meets-in-d-c): Coverage of autism researchers countering vaccine skepticism in federal advisory panel
- [What's the most massive star in the universe?](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/whats-the-most-massive-star-in-the-universe): Astronomy explainer on stellar mass and cosmic history by Phil Plait

## Multimedia & Podcasts

- [The real science (and the fun fiction) behind Project Hail Mary](https://www.scientificamerican.com/podcast/episode/the-real-science-and-the-fun-fiction-behind-project-hail-mary): Podcast interview with author Andy Weir about Project Hail Mary science and fiction

## Core & Access

- [Scientific American](https://www.scientificamerican.com): Homepage featuring latest science news, articles, and multimedia content
- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm.](https://www.scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Subscription and access page for Scientific American magazine and digital products

## Optional

- [Spellements](https://www.scientificamerican.com/game/spellements): Interactive word puzzle game with science-themed daily letter selections
